title: Discrete Mathematics and Combinatorics
summary: Finite structures and counting arguments, progressing from bijections and double counting through graph theory, generating functions, recurrences, matching, matroids and extremal combinatorics. Distinct from the Algorithms course: mathematical structure and proof first.
assumed_background: finite sets, algebra, and willingness to follow an elementary proof

lectures.title: Bijections and Double Counting: Proving Equations by Counting Objects
Generating Functions: Turn Counting into Algebra
Recurrences, Rational Generating Functions, and Growth
